metadata.source_review_scope: Source-map local-metal heteromeric candidates from the bounded canonical EC/Pfam ePK ligand scout.

candidate_phosphoacceptor_mapping.candidate_source_mapping: RCSB primary citation and entry title identify a substrate peptide bound to phospho-CDK2/cyclin A; the source article describes peptide-substrate and recruitment-peptide specificity for cyclin-dependent kinases.

geometry.local_metal: MG at 2.356 Angstrom from ATP PG
MG at 2.565 Angstrom from ATP PG

candidate_phosphoacceptor_mapping.source_mapping: 2CCI entity 3 is a 30-residue human CDC6 peptide mapped by struct_ref_seq to UniProt Q99741 residues 71-100. Entity sequence position 4 is Ser and maps to UniProt CDC6 Ser74; SIFTS/PDB seq_dif flags engineered mutations at neighboring positions 71, 72, 73, and 76, but not at Ser74.
candidate_phosphoacceptor_mapping.source_site_context: The primary 2CCI article states that the pCDK2/cyclin A complex was solved with a 30-residue CDC6 peptide, with a heptapeptide bound at the catalytic site and the linking residues unresolved. Independent CDC6 phosphorylation evidence identifies human CDC6 Ser54, Ser74, and Ser106 as Cdk2 in-vitro and in-vivo phosphorylation sites.

source_limitations: Peptide substrate only; not a folded-protein substrate positive.
The CDC6 peptide is engineered at flanking residues to generate the active-site sequence, although the mapped Ser74 acceptor is not flagged as engineered.
Geometry is within the lane 6 Angstrom bound but near the upper edge, so it is useful for review stress rather than production thresholding.
The source article reports unresolved linker density between catalytic-site and recruitment-site peptide segments.

sibling_followups.source_context: 2CCH is the same primary-citation sibling of 2CCI and is described by RCSB/PDB header as a CDC6 substrate peptide modified with a gamma-linked ATP analogue; the header states the ATP gamma phosphate is covalently attached by a linker to an amino analogue of the hydroxyl acceptor amino acid.
source_limitations: No Mg/Mn is modeled near ATP PG under the lane scan.
No heteromeric Ser/Thr/Tyr acceptor is within 6 Angstrom of ATP PG.
The acceptor is represented as a modified amino analogue/linker inhibitor context, not a normal source-mapped hydroxyl acceptor in a transfer-ready substrate.

evidence_against: The bounded canonical search did not expose a fresh folded-protein substrate positive; the only fresh local-metal source-mapped candidate is a peptide/substrate-fragment complex.
2CCI has engineered flanking residues and unresolved linker density, so it should not be used to activate production labels or thresholds.
2CCH is an equivalent analog/inhibitor sibling but has no local Mg/Mn and no normal heteromeric hydroxyl acceptor within 6 Angstrom of ATP PG.
evidence_for: 2CCI is a fresh source-mapped peptide positive: pCDK2/cyclin A ATP/Mg has CDC6 Ser74 OG within 5.821-5.995 Angstrom of ATP PG across two chains.
1QMZ is a repeat source-clean peptide positive recovered by the canonical EC/Pfam ligand screen.
source_review_summary.recommendation: Add 2CCI only as review-only peptide positive evidence. Keep production scoring, threshold calibration, label import, registries, fingerprints, and migrations closed.
